create_gym_env: create a Gym environment with a TimeLimit wrapper using make_gym_env
create_atari_env: create an Atari environment with DeepMind and PyTorch wrappers using make_atari_env
build_MLP: build a multi-layer perceptron with configurable sizes and activation functions using MLP
build_DQNMLPAgent: build a DQN agent with an MLP network for tabular environments using DQNMLPAgent
build_DQNAtariAgent: build a DQN agent with a dueling CNN for Atari environments using DQNAtariAgent
